What's really happening inside

Skin and hair are the body's report card. They're the first place where toxins, stress, poor sleep and weak nutrition show up — long before anything serious appears in a blood report. Dullness, breakouts, premature wrinkles, hair on the pillow every morning: these are signals, not cosmetic inconveniences.

And the signals are getting louder, younger: acne is persisting well past the teens, hair fall is starting in the early 20s, and pollution plus hard water in Indian cities are making both worse. Creams and serums treat the outside — but the outside is just the screen; the projection happens from inside.

That's why cosmetic fixes disappoint: the skin and hair you see are fed from within. Clean the body, absorb nutrients properly, and the outside catches up fast.

Our approach

The 90-day skin & hair restore program

Working from the inside out — because that's where skin and hair are actually built.

  1. Detoxify. Stabilized aloe vera helps the body clear the accumulated toxins that surface as dullness, breakouts and premature aging — and it improves nutrient absorption in the small intestine, so everything you eat actually reaches the skin and hair follicles.
  2. Feed the roots. Vitamins, minerals and amino acids from aloe-based nutrition give hair follicles and skin cells the raw material to rebuild — from within, where cosmetics can't reach.
  3. Repair for 90 days. Skin renews itself in roughly 4-week cycles and hair grows in months-long phases — 90 days is the honest minimum for visible change, and people who complete it properly see it: clearer skin, thicker feel, glow that doesn't wash off.
